import re, zlib, struct
p="<LOCAL_WORK>/work/acceptance_r2/sources_e3/R2 选矿厂磨机振动频谱分析-扫描件.pdf"
d=open(p,'rb').read()
m=re.search(rb'/Width 1240/Height 1754.*?stream\r?\n', d, re.S)
start=m.end()
raw=d[start:start+1240*1754*3]
print("raw len",len(raw))
w,h=1240,1754
rows=b''.join(b'\x00'+raw[y*w*3:(y+1)*w*3] for y in range(h))
def chunk(t,data):
    c=t+data
    return struct.pack('>I',len(data))+c+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(c)&0xffffffff)
png=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,2,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(rows,6))+chunk(b'IEND',b'')
open('scan.png','wb').write(png)
print("png",len(png))
EOF
